title: Your AI chats are deleted every 90 days
description:
Your chat history, your personal settings, your agents and skills -- stored in a hidden folder that gets wiped every 90 days. Copy your project to a new machine? None of it comes with you.

Valo keeps everything in one folder you control. Move it, back it up, start on any machine -- it just works.

Full 36-minute working session: https://youtube.com/watch?v=alOvTm5SpGI

#ai #coding #developer #valo #claude #codex
